composition_summary: Proposed one unapproved class-22 pure-logic candidate pc-check-timeout-ms (name/description/content only). It reads timeout_ms via inputs.get, treats valid as an exact integer in 0..7500 inclusive excluding bool/float/missing/null, and returns {valid, timeout_ms} with null on invalid. No submission or activation; the target typed-inputs interface is not guaranteed runtime support and Q1/Q2 plus exact-association approval precede activation.
adjusted_volatile_messages: We need to validate raw timeout values before configuring a service.

payload.name: pc-check-timeout-ms
payload.description: Pure-logic validation of a raw timeout_ms value. Returns valid=true only for an exact integer in 0..7500 inclusive; booleans, floats, missing, null and out-of-range values yield valid=false with timeout_ms=null. No Tool calls, imports or I/O.
payload.content:
# Raw candidate: missing/invalid timeout_ms returns an invalid result, not an exception.
timeout_ms = inputs.get("timeout_ms")
valid = isinstance(timeout_ms, int) and not isinstance(timeout_ms, bool) and 0 <= timeout_ms <= 7500
result = {"valid": valid, "timeout_ms": timeout_ms if valid else None}
